messages:
Maggie: Quick sync — ACME cloud catalog joint demo sprint. Need launch post, benchmark narrative, webinar date, and inbound lead routing map. Who's owning creative? 
Jonah: I can take lead routing. Want to map to PR and demo funnel. Suggesting: marketplace leads -> sales-ops queue -> demo nurture flow. 
Sara: @Jonah perfect. I can own webinar content + run-of-show. Dates? next Tue/Thu windows work. 
Devon: ACME partner says they're flexible week of 2025-05-12. Prefer Tue. Also offering engineered demo environment. 
Kaya: I'll draft launch post and blog outline. Do we have benchmark numbers to call out? latency/cost vs hosted combo? 
Maggie: Good q. Research ask to eng-ml: small benchmark vs public model on 8xA100. Keep language simple for customer-facing. @Devon can you confirm test vectors? 
Devon: Yep — will share sample prompts + perf csv by EOD tomorrow. 
Jonah: Routing snippet (rough):
```
marketplace-leads:
  - route: salesops-demo
  - tag: acme_marketplace
  - fallback: marketing-nurture
```
Use lead source UTM param to attach tags. 
Sara: For the webinar: 30min total. 10m intro, 10m live demo, 8m partner use-case, 2m CTAs + Qs. Need speaker names + slides by Wed. 
Maggie: Creative checklist: hero screenshot, 2 benchmark callouts, 3 customer quotes (if ACME can provide), CTA to sign up + marketplace listing. 
Kaya: I'll create draft blog + subject lines. Two tones: technical benchmark and customer story. Which one do we prioritize for the marketplace? 
Devon: Marketplace listing prefers short benefit-driven copy. Use the technical blog as follow-up. 
Jonah: I'll wire up routing in HubSpot. Need final UTM schema and destination queue. Post the final rules here when set. 
campaign-bot: Reminder: marketing calendar event "ACME joint webinar" created for 2025-05-13 10:00 PT — RSVP link: https://calendar.example/evt/abc123 
Maggie: Thanks @campaign-bot. Action items: 
- @Devon deliver prompts + perf csv (EOD tomorrow) 
- @Kaya draft blog + 2 subject lines (Tue morning) 
- @Sara slides + run-of-show (Wed EOD) 
- @Jonah implement routing + share rules (Thu morning) 
We'll do a final dry run Fri morning. Anyone object? 
Kaya: all good from content side :+1: 
Jonah: 👍 will confirm HubSpot queue and webhook. 
Sara: Ok for dry run. Will prep speaker notes. 
Devon: ACME will send 2 short customer quotes by Wed. 
Maggie: Great — I'm scheduling a 30m sync Fri 9am PT to review. Thanks team :rocket:
